findings.location: Increment A and its dependency before Increments B–D
findings.problem: Increment A changes the current specs to promise both fixes before any helper implements them. The project policy says specs state what is true now, so after A the documented contract would be false for all three shipped bridges.
findings.suggestion: Move each documentation change into the increment that implements its behavior, or update the common contract only after B–D have landed; preserve dependencies so no committed increment leaves a current spec ahead of the code.

findings.problem: The required test matrix covers five spellings, relative and absolute paths, optional trailing slashes, and descendants in every bridge, but B lists only selected examples and C/D merely refer back to it. The plan does not specify coverage sufficient to demonstrate the stated criterion.
findings.suggestion: Define a shared explicit parameterized matrix for all required spellings/forms and descendants, state which canonical cases are retained existing coverage versus new regressions, and require it in each module increment.

summary: The plan has two material gaps: it would make current specs temporarily untrue, and its proposed tests do not fully cover its stated root-path matrix.
